control: T2-47 — отдельный source node; каждый pre-1500 text появляется здесь только как reception/handoff.
needed_sources: Edition chronology; T2-47 registry; early Joseon institutional records.
risk: Early Joseon and pre-1500 corpora могут быть повторены или, наоборот, искусственно отрезаны.

control: Моделировать letter-event, date, sender, recipient, quoted proposition and edition separately.
needed_sources: Critical Korean editions; munjip witnesses; correspondence studies.
risk: Поздняя компиляция может скрыть последовательность писем, редакторов и расхождения witnesses.

control: School label — reception node, не свойства каждого тезиса.
needed_sources: Primary correspondence and seowon curricula; specialist monographs.
risk: Учебниковая бинарность поглощает Ki Taesŭng, Sŏng Hon, Cho Sik, later lineages and internal change.

control: Для каждого автора фиксировать self-description, network, shared text and later historiography.
needed_sources: Munjip, travel records, Tasan/Ch’oe editions, modern historiography.
risk: Ретроспективный umbrella превращается в организованную self-conscious school.

control: Связать monastery, print, patronage, polemic, regulation and philosophical text.
needed_sources: KABC, temple editions, legal/institutional records, Korean Buddhism scholarship.
risk: Institutional repression ошибочно равняется textual extinction; либо surviving texts идеализируются вне social constraints.

control: Разделить author, compiler, editor, publisher, dedicatory voice and witness.
needed_sources: Yunjidang/Chŏngildang editions; family records; gender scholarship.
risk: Family editing и посмертная печать используются для отрицания agency или скрываются ради «великой авторки».

control: Версионировать script use по жанрам, аудиториям, полу, статусу и региону.
needed_sources: Book-history studies; bilingual witnesses; print catalogues.
risk: Создание script и фактические жанровые/социальные изменения схлопываются.

control: Создать отдельные formation, fixation, canonization and political-reception nodes.
risk: Учение Ch’oe Che-u, печатный канон, Ch’ŏndogyo and 1894 movement смешиваются.

control: Одновременно кодировать imperial institution, censorship, local translation, appropriation and resistance.
needed_sources: Keijō curricula, colonial journals, police/censorship archives, colonial-modernity scholarship.
risk: Нарратив колеблется между полной passive victimhood и neutral progress.

control: Хранить historical categories and modern disciplinary classification as separate labels.
needed_sources: Lexical history, early textbooks, curricula and history-of-philosophy studies.
risk: Современное слово ретроецируется на ранние тексты или используется, чтобы исключить их из философии.

control: Создать separate CLC/institution nodes with access confidence and no false symmetry.
needed_sources: North Korean publications/catalogues; South Korean databases; diaspora archives.
risk: Южнокорейская academia принимается за всю Korean philosophy; North reduced to slogan.

control: Каждой transmission присваивать channel, date, actor and transformation; национальный label не является causal edge.
needed_sources: Cross-regional editions, travel and education records, comparative scholarship.
risk: Корея изображается как timeless unity или passive Chinese/Japanese periphery.

control: Digital object linked to base witness; record version, OCR/manual transcription, licence and coverage.
needed_sources: Platform documentation, metadata exports, image-text comparison, repository audits.
risk: Нормализованная транскрипция, ranking and repository coverage скрывают variant, absence and rights barriers.

contribution: Тезисы, возражения и ревизии T’oegye и Ki Taesŭng о Four Beginnings, Seven Emotions, i/ki и moral agency.
reliability: Очень высокая для существования и содержания корпуса; требуется edition-level audit каждого письма и различение поздних munjip-редакций.
source_label: [P01] Four–Seven correspondence, 1559–1566

contribution: Связывает канон, космологию, mind, kyŏng, self-cultivation и political pedagogy; опорный master-anchor.
reliability: Очень высокая; фиксировать состав диаграмм, источники цитат, рукописно-печатные свидетели и позднюю школьную рецепцию.
source_label: [P02] Yi Hwang, Sŏnghak sipto / Ten Diagrams, 1568

contribution: Системная программа образования государя, управления mind, ritual, office и governance.
reliability: Очень высокая; перевод не заменяет hanmun-текст, а политический адресат не равен фактической реализации.
source_label: [P03] Yi I, Sŏnghak chipyo / Essentials of the Learning of the Sages, 1575

contribution: Повседневная дисциплина учёбы и аргументативный спор о i/ki, mind, emotions и cultivation.
reliability: Высокая; составной dossier должен быть разложен на отдельные произведения и письма с датами.
source_label: [P04] Yi I, Kyŏngmong yogyŏl, 1577; Yi I–Sŏng Hon correspondence

contribution: Аргументы о способности женщин к sagehood, human nature и универсальности moral cultivation.
reliability: Высокая для сохранившегося корпуса; family editing, отбор и посмертное печатание обязательны как provenance.
source_label: [P05] Im Yunjidang, Yunjidang yugo, посмертная печать 1796

contribution: Движение Земли, множественность миров, децентрация человеческой перспективы и критика civilizational exclusivity.
reliability: Высокая; композиционный контекст и relation к travel/Qing knowledge требуют edition-level проверки.
source_label: [P06] Hong Taeyong, Ŭisan mundap, c. 1766

contribution: Наблюдение техники, торговли, институтов и языка как средство социальной и цивилизационной критики.
reliability: Очень высокая для корпуса; гибридный жанр нельзя превращать ни только в travelogue, ни в системный трактат.
source_label: [P07] Pak Chiwŏn, Yŏrha ilgi, 1780

contribution: Архитектура должности, local government, welfare, доказательств, наказания и судебного суждения.
reliability: Очень высокая; три текста имеют разные адресаты и статус, поэтому не сливать их в один абстрактный ‘Tasan doctrine’.
source_label: [P08] Chŏng Yagyong: Kyŏngse yup’yo, Mongmin simsŏ, Hŭmhŭm sinsŏ, 1817–1819

contribution: Ki-centered cosmology, sensory knowledge, circulation, geography и программа universal learning.
reliability: Высокая; корпус распределён по произведениям и редакциям, а modern science vocabulary требует исторического контроля.
source_label: [P09] Ch’oe Han-gi corpus, 1836–1867

contribution: Аргументированная защита буддийской ортодоксии и института в конфуцианском государстве.
reliability: Высокая при опоре на корейский Buddhist corpus; нужны текст, variant и контекст преследования/восстановления.
source_label: [P10] Pŏu, Ilchŏngnon, XVI в.

contribution: Mind-cultivation, meditation, awakening, relation Sŏn and doctrinal learning; долговременный учебный afterlife.
reliability: Очень высокая; учитывать разные издания и переводы, не сводить к практическому handbook без философской структуры.
source_label: [P11] Hyujŏng, Sŏn’ga kwigam, XVI в.

contribution: Human–Heaven relation, sincerity, practice, equality and communal reform; разводит formation и print fixation.
reliability: Очень высокая для печатного корпуса; авторский слой, раннее редактирование и Ch’ŏndogyo afterlife должны быть разделены.
source_label: [P12] Ch’oe Che-u, Donggyŏng taejŏn: идеи 1860-х, печать 1880

contribution: Корейскоязычная передача cosmology, ethics и communal discipline более широкой аудитории.
reliability: Очень высокая; песенная форма и поздняя печать требуют отдельной модели composition–performance–edition.
source_label: [P13] Ch’oe Che-u, Yongdam yusa: идеи 1860-х, печать 1881

contribution: Критика института, образования и monastic discipline; relation Buddhism, nation and modern public responsibility.
reliability: Очень высокая для печатного текста; различать дату написания, издание 1913 и позднюю nationalist canonization.
source_label: [P14] Han Yongun, Chosŏn Pulgyo Yusinnon, 1909–1910 / 1913

contribution: Курсы, библиотеки, disciplinary labels, censorship и публикации Keijō Imperial University и иных школ.
reliability: Высокая как архивный слой, но неоднородная; colonial institution, Japanese faculty и Korean student agency кодировать раздельно.
source_label: [P15] Colonial philosophy curricula, catalogues and journals, 1910–1945

contribution: Основание кафедр, degree-canon, curricula, faculty lines и специализация философского поля.
reliability: Высокая для официальной хронологии; self-history departments требует сверки с архивами, course lists и персональными dossiers.
source_label: [P16] Post-1945 university catalogues and department histories

contribution: Серийное поле статей, тем, переводов, рецензий и disciplinary boundary-making после войны.
reliability: Очень высокая для опубликованного журнала; metadata, issue scans, title changes и indexing coverage проверять по выпускам.
source_label: [P17] CHEOLHAK / Korean Philosophical Association, 1955–

contribution: Отдельная северокорейская institutional ecology: Marxism–Leninism, Juche, history of Korean thought, ethics and education.
reliability: Средняя из-за ограниченного доступа и edition-control; нельзя реконструировать поле только по южнокорейским или западным пересказам.
source_label: [P18] North Korean philosophical textbooks and Juche corpora, 1945–2026

contribution: Contemporary subfields, university requirements, journals, associations, citation and repository regime.
reliability: Высокая для доступных records на дату среза; динамический и неполный корпус, требующий versioned snapshot и language-bias audit.
source_label: [P19] Current journals, curricula and syllabi: snapshot 2026-09-01

contribution: Девять академий, spatial/institutional функции обучения, memorial rite и landscape; контекст material survival.
reliability: Очень высокая для heritage facts; не является интерпретацией doctrines и не заменяет academy records.
source_label: [D01] UNESCO, Seowon, Korean Neo-Confucian Academies

contribution: Royal library, manuscripts, printed books, maps, documents and institutional history; ключ к late-Joseon editorial state.
reliability: Очень высокая; catalogue record и digital image нужно связывать с конкретным shelfmark/witness.
source_label: [D02] Kyujanggak Institute for Korean Studies

contribution: Hanmun originals, Korean translations, image files and authority paths для major munjip and statecraft corpora.
reliability: Очень высокая для discovery and access; punctuation, translation, normalized text и base edition должны быть versioned.
source_label: [D03] Integrated Database of Korean Classics / ITKC

contribution: Связывает manuscripts, documents, genealogies, maps, person/place authority and multiple institutional projects.
reliability: Высокая; aggregation может скрывать различия metadata models, duplicate objects и external ownership.
source_label: [D04] KOSTMA — Korean Studies Materials gateway

contribution: Korean Buddhist texts, canon records, bibliographic apparatus and modern combined canon infrastructure.
reliability: Очень высокая для Buddhist text discovery; edition and witness hierarchy проверять на уровне item.
source_label: [D05] KABC, Archive of Cultural Heritage of Buddhist Records

contribution: Premodern and modern documents, chronicles, colonial and post-liberation materials; contextual institutional evidence.
reliability: Очень высокая для official digitized collections; тематическая выдача не равна полноте философского корпуса.
source_label: [D06] National Institute of Korean History digital materials

contribution: Royal, family and private archival materials; crucial for yugo, family editing, women’s writings and documentary provenance.
reliability: Очень высокая; access interface and digitization coverage require collection-level notes.
source_label: [D07] Digital Jangseogak

contribution: Historical editions, modern books, journals, newspapers and bibliographic authority for print afterlives.
reliability: Очень высокая для holdings metadata; full-text access varies and holding date is not composition date.
source_label: [D08] National Library of Korea

contribution: Current Korean journal metadata, field distribution, citations and article discovery.
reliability: Высокая for indexed publications; coverage rules create visibility bias and exclude parts of historical/non-commercial output.
source_label: [D09] Korean Citation Index

contribution: Theses, dissertations, articles, books and institutional records; useful for current curricula and Korean-language scholarship.
reliability: Высокая as discovery layer; records and access rights vary, duplicate/romanization normalization required.
source_label: [D10] RISS International

contribution: Post-liberation foundation chronology, department continuity and programme identity.
reliability: Высокая for self-reported dates; corroborate with catalogues, archived curricula and faculty records.
source_label: [D11] Korea University Philosophy Department history

contribution: Contemporary department structure, curricula and field labels; snapshot of professional canon.
reliability: Высокая only as dated institutional snapshot; pages change and do not represent the whole Korean field.
source_label: [D12] Seoul National University Department of Philosophy

contribution: KPA infrastructure, CHEOLHAK journal, submissions, issue metadata and professional boundary maintenance.
reliability: Very high for current official records; archive completeness and earlier issue digitization need manual verification.
source_label: [D13] Korean Philosophical Association / JAMS

contribution: Общая карта Korean philosophical agency, T’oegye/Yulgok, debates, Tasan and modern field.
limitations: Очень высокая как обзор; агрегирующая схема требует specialist checks по текстам и периодам.
source_label: [S01] Halla Kim, “Korean Philosophy”, Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy

contribution: Neo-Confucian transmission, Four–Seven, Horak, institutions and Korean transformations of Cheng–Zhu resources.
limitations: Очень высокая; не заменяет correspondence editions и regional school studies.
source_label: [S02] “Korean Confucianism”, Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy

contribution: Wŏnhyo/Ŭisang/Chinul, Korean doctrinal synthesis, Sŏn and Buddhist–Confucian interfaces.
limitations: Очень высокая; broad synthesis, medieval focus stronger than full modern institutional history.
source_label: [S03] “Korean Buddhism”, Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy

contribution: Основной англоязычный debate dossier: letters, chronology, technical vocabulary and interpretive apparatus.
limitations: Фундаментальный; translation decisions must be checked against hanmun and later scholarship.
source_label: [S04] Michael C. Kalton et al., The Four-Seven Debate, 1994

contribution: Сравнительная реконструкция i/ki, mind, emotions and cultivation in two major systems.
limitations: Фундаментальный; two-figure framing can underrepresent correspondence networks and other schools.
source_label: [S05] Edward Y. J. Chung, The Korean Neo-Confucianism of Yi T’oegye and Yi Yulgok, 1995

contribution: Transmission from late Goryeo to Joseon, social and textual institutionalization.
limitations: Классический reference work; older field frame should be supplemented by gender, material-text and coloniality studies.
source_label: [S06] de Bary & JaHyun Kim Haboush, eds., The Rise of Neo-Confucianism in Korea, 1985

contribution: Kinship, ritual, status and social institutionalization of Neo-Confucian norms.
limitations: Очень сильна institution/social history; less suited as a text-critical guide to individual arguments.
source_label: [S07] Martina Deuchler, The Confucian Transformation of Korea, 1992/1993

contribution: Gendered authorship, education, family mediation and women’s participation in Confucian textual culture.
limitations: Сильный corrective; heterogeneous essays, not a single theory of women’s philosophy.
source_label: [S08] Youngmin Kim & Michael J. Pettid, eds., Women and Confucianism in Chosŏn Korea, 2011

contribution: Focused philosophical interpretation of Yunjidang on sagehood, gender and moral capacity.
limitations: Очень высокая for figure-level analysis; must remain linked to posthumous edition history.
source_label: [S09] Sungmoon Kim, Im Yunjidang, 2022

contribution: Comparative and text-based recovery of Korean women philosophers and sagehood arguments.
limitations: Очень высокая; translated selection still requires Korean/hanmun witness alignment.
source_label: [S10] Ivanhoe & Hwa Yeong Wang, Korean Women Philosophers and the Ideal of a Female Sage, 2023

contribution: Tasan/statecraft in relation to institutions, reform limits and political economy.
limitations: Фундаментальный; institution-centered and large-scale, so individual texts need separate edition audit.
source_label: [S11] James B. Palais, Confucian Statecraft and Korean Institutions, 1996

contribution: Tasan’s conceptual challenge, human nature, moral agency and relation to Neo-Confucian orthodoxy.
limitations: High-value monograph; linked page is a review record, not digital full text.
source_label: [S12] Mark Setton, Chŏng Yagyong: Korea’s Challenge to Orthodox Neo-Confucianism, 1997

contribution: Recent reconstruction of Ch’oe Han-gi’s ki, knowledge and universal-science project.
limitations: Высокая; focused thesis should not become the only interpretation of a large corpus.
source_label: [S13] Seonhee Kim, “Choe Hangi’s Gihak: Universal Science and the Fusion of Eastern and Western Knowledge”, 2023

contribution: Hong’s cosmology and critique of Sinocentric civilizational hierarchy.
limitations: Высокая; thematic article, not complete textual history of Ŭisan mundap.
source_label: [S14] Young-bae Song, “Countering Sinocentrism in Eighteenth-Century Korea: Hong Tae-Yong’s Vision…”, 1999

contribution: Chinul, sudden/gradual cultivation and Korean Sŏn background for later afterlives.
limitations: Фундаментальный; medieval anchor enters T3-50 only through documented reception.
source_label: [S15] Robert E. Buswell Jr., Tracing Back the Radiance: Chinul’s Korean Way of Zen

contribution: Chŏng Tojŏn and Kihwa as immediate prehistory of Joseon Buddhist–Confucian polemic.
limitations: Очень высокая; boundary source from T2-47, not a substitute for sixteenth-century Pŏu/Hyujŏng.
source_label: [S16] A. Charles Muller, Korea’s Great Buddhist-Confucian Debate, 2015

contribution: Wide chronological set of translated primary texts, including modernity and Korean doctrinal agency.
limitations: Очень высокая current sourcebook; English selection cannot define the complete Korean-language corpus.
source_label: [S17] Jin Y. Park & Sumi Lee, eds., Korean Buddhism: Selected Readings from Primary Texts, 2026

contribution: Colonial modernity as asymmetric yet locally mediated transformation of culture, institutions and knowledge.
limitations: Фундаментальный framework; not philosophy-specific and must be paired with curricular/textual evidence.
source_label: [S18] Gi-Wook Shin & Michael Robinson, eds., Colonial Modernity in Korea, 1999/2001

contribution: Student body, courses, graduation patterns, careers and the Philosophy Discussion Society under colonial rule.
limitations: Очень высокая for documented institution; Korean-language and student-centered, not full intellectual biography.
source_label: [S19] Heo Ji-hyang, “Students of the Philosophy Department, Faculty of Law and Literature, Keijō Imperial University”, 2023

contribution: Formation, translation and appropriation of 철학; relation to premodern knowledge terms and colonial mediation.
limitations: Очень высокая; concept history does not itself inventory all philosophical genres or institutions.
source_label: [S20] Haenghoon Lee, “The Historical Semantics of the Modern Korean Concept of Philosophy”, 2011

contribution: Self-understanding in prefaces to Korean introductions/translations after war; reconstruction of disciplinary purpose.
limitations: Очень высокая and recent; focused on introductions/prefaces, not the entire 1950s field.
source_label: [S21] Min Cheol Park, “What ‘Philosophy’ Meant to Korean Philosophers in the 1950s…”, 2025

contribution: Post-1950s chronology, societies, journals, translations and consolidation of analytic philosophy.
limitations: Высокая and current; subfield-centered, and its periodization should not stand for all Korean philosophy.
source_label: [S22] Pedersen, Bae, Kim, Kim & Park, “The Emergence of Analytic Philosophy in Korea”, 2024

contribution: Problem-centered readings of Korean figures, Four–Seven, Horak, women, Tasan and comparative relevance.
limitations: Очень высокая for philosophical argument; curated English-language canon, requiring Korean bibliography and excluded-node audit.
source_label: [S23] Youngsun Back & Philip J. Ivanhoe, eds., Traditional Korean Philosophy: Problems and Debates, 2016
